## CollisionSparkParticleEffects_004ec1a0 — CollisionSparkAndDamageParticleEffects

**Summary:** Per-frame collision response visual/audio effects: computes collision damage from force magnitude and direction, dispatches spark particle effects at contact points (8 body + 4 wheel zones), triggers repair/damage service events, applies steering geometry deformation, and resets tire scrub on severe impacts.

**Frame-path:** ON_FRAME_PATH  
**Call frequency:** per-frame tick

**Called by:** VehicleContactForceAccumulation (004ebc60)

**Guard conditions (deterministic — field vs literal):**

| Base | Offset | Test | Value | Field / meaning |
|------|--------|------|-------|-----------------|
| this | 0x32BC | != | 1 | vehicle collision processing mode (1 = spectator/restricted, blocks during race phases 1/3) |

**Guard interpretation:** When this+0x32BC != 1, collision spark processing always PASSES (proceeds to particle effects). When == 1 (restricted mode), race phase is checked: if dword_7C56A8 is neither 1 nor 3, still PASSES. Only BLOCKED when == 1 AND race phase is exactly 1 or 3 (likely pre-race / formation lap where collision sparks should be suppressed).
